items.criterion: Access RubyGems rails gem page (without sign-in)
items.description: Attempt to use RubyGems as the source by navigating to the rails gem page (e.g., https://rubygems.org/gems/rails). Full credit if the agent attempts RubyGems but is blocked by an uncontrollable issue (CAPTCHA, outage, region block) and clearly reports this. Partial credit if another source is used despite RubyGems being accessible.

items.criterion: Respect constraints: no sign-in, no download/install
items.description: Do not sign in and do not download or install the gem. Full credit if the agent stays within these constraints; no credit if it signs in or claims to download/install.

items.criterion: Identify the latest displayed Rails version
items.description: Correctly determine the latest Rails version number as displayed on RubyGems. Full credit if the version corresponds to the latest displayed release. Partial credit if the agent reports a near-latest version and explains that the latest version could not be confirmed due to an uncontrollable display/loading issue on RubyGems. Full credit if RubyGems is inaccessible and the agent explicitly states it cannot verify the latest displayed version.

items.criterion: Record latest version metadata (version, release date, required Ruby, license)
items.description: Report the latest displayed version’s metadata from RubyGems: (1) version, (2) release date, (3) required Ruby version, and (4) license. Full credit if all four fields are accurately captured from RubyGems. Partial credit if one field is missing/unclear but the agent states it was not visible due to an uncontrollable page issue. Full credit if RubyGems is inaccessible and the agent clearly reports it cannot retrieve these metadata fields.

items.criterion: Runtime dependency #1 in displayed order (name + requirement)
items.description: Provide the first runtime dependency exactly as displayed on RubyGems’ dependencies section/page for the latest version, including its version requirement, preserving order. Full credit if correct. Partial credit if correct gem name but incorrect/missing requirement or order. Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to view runtime dependencies but RubyGems fails to display them (and the agent clearly reports this). No credit if a development dependency is used when runtime dependencies are visible.

Full credit if runtime dependencies cannot be accessed due to an uncontrollable RubyGems issue after a reasonable attempt and the agent states this.
